environment: Codex in-app Chromium, Vite preview serving built dist, Go API, PostgreSQL 16.14 isolated schema, synthetic administrator/member; no LiveKit service

checks.name: auth_and_admin_topology
checks.detail: Administrator login, creation of a category and TEXT channel, channel rename with immediate navigation update, logout and logged-out reload passed.

checks.name: responsive_text_shell
checks.detail: At 1440/1280/1024 CSS px, document scrollWidth equaled viewport width. Measured sidebar/main/members widths were 280/912/248, 264/743/240 and 256/735/0 CSS px respectively; 1024 used a members drawer.

checks.name: keyboard_focus
checks.detail: At 1024 CSS px, members drawer exposed dialog semantics; Escape closed it and restored focus to its opener. Search dialog focused its query; Escape restored focus to the search trigger. Ctrl+K in the TEXT composer did not open search.

limitations: The bundle was built and previewed locally, not deployed through the trusted release pipeline.
Reset completion, attachment upload, DM notifications, voice/media/reconnect, screen-reader, zoom 125/150% and stored screenshot comparison were not completed in this run.
No full visual parity claim or QA-05 PASS follows from these checks.
